Land at PEK.basis: PEK airport guides say international arrivals take ~1h to clear fingerprinting/passport control and collect bags (immigration alone 30-60 min), plus deplaning a widebody and the long T2 walk.

Drop bags at Regent Beijing.basis: TripAdvisor reviews of the Regent describe fast, smooth bell-desk luggage storage before check-in; no evidence of queues, so 20 min is a reasoned allowance for tagging and freshening up.

Breakfast.basis: TripAdvisor reviewers repeatedly call the Regent Beijing buffet one of the best in China - wide Chinese and Western spread, eggs cooked to order plus an a la carte menu - which is an hour's worth of eating, not a 20-minute refuel.

Temple of Heaven.basis: TripAdvisor reviews and China travel guides converge on 1-2h for the main halls and 2-3h if you also enjoy the park and the locals exercising; 2h fits the North Gate joint-ticket route.

Lunch.basis: Restaurant-industry benchmarks put a full-service seated meal at 75-105 min from seating to check; Chinese lunches run at the quicker end of that per China dining-culture guides.

Beijing city model.basis: TravelChinaGuide and tour-beijing put the visit at 1-2h, recommending ~40 min on the 1:750 scale model alone before the historical and multimedia floors.

Dinner.basis: Full-service dinners run 75-105 min per restaurant benchmarks, and China dining guides note diners routinely linger 30+ min after the food chatting - so 1.5h is the honest figure.

Qianmen & hutongs.basis: Beijing walking guides time the Liulichang-Dashilan-Qianmen stroll at about 1.5h, with 1-2h quoted for a quick wander and half a day only if you shop and eat.

Shichahai lakes.basis: AllTrails logs the Shichahai loop at 2.2 miles / 44 min average walking, and Beijing guides suggest 1-2h to actually soak up the bar lights and lakeside atmosphere at dusk.

Tiananmen Square.basis: Guides say allocate ~2h including queuing, but note non-holiday weekday security waits are under 30 min and before 09:00 is the quietest slot - so ~30 min entry plus 45 min on the square.

Forbidden City.basis: Guides put the central axis at 2-3h and 4-5h if you add the Treasure and Clock galleries; Meridian Gate security is a further 15-20 min off-peak, so 3.5h is the unhurried first-timer figure.

Jingshan Park.basis: Trip.com and TripAdvisor reports give a 5-15 min climb each way (about 150 steps) and an average visit around 30 min, stretching to 2h only for dedicated photographers.

National Museum.basis: TripAdvisor reviewers and museum guides say most people spend 2-3h and enthusiasts 4-6h, with the Ancient China galleries alone quoted at 2-3h; add the passport/security check on entry.

Wangfujing.basis: Guides say half a day to a full day if you seriously shop the malls, but TripAdvisor reviews of the street itself describe an hour-ish wander among stalls, screens and bookstores.

Mutianyu Great Wall.basis: TripAdvisor Q&A and China guides say most visitors spend 2-3h at Mutianyu including the cable car and several watchtowers (3-4h for a thorough hike); the toboggan is counted separately here.

Toboggan down.basis: Rider reports and operator guides put the descent itself at 5-10 min depending on braking; the rest is the walk to the launch platform, the safety briefing and the summer queue.

Sanlitun Taikoo Li.basis: Beijing guides suggest 3-5h to explore both Taikoo Li zones leisurely and 1-2h for a quick pass; with dinner folded in, 2.5h is a realistic evening.

CCTV 'Big Pants'.n: Exterior photo stop in the CBD
CCTV 'Big Pants'.basis: Guides note interior access is staff-only and visitors typically spend 20-60 min photographing from the open plaza or the free China World Mall viewing terrace.

Mutianyu night tour.basis: The official Mutianyu night session runs 17:30-21:00 with lighting from 19:00 and last ticket check 20:30; operator listings describe roughly a 3.5h on-site sunset-and-lights visit.

Summer Palace.basis: Multiple guides state 3-4h is the minimum for a visit that feels worthwhile and that 2h is only a skim of this very spread-out site; the North Palace Gate to Longevity Hill to ferry route fits 3.5h.

798 Art District.basis: TripAdvisor and district guides give 2h for a highlights loop and 2-4h for a typical visit (4-5h for art devotees); 2.5h covers the outdoor art and smaller galleries with UCCA timed separately.

UCCA.basis: Visitor write-ups say the UCCA halls are compact enough to walk through in about an hour; the extra 15 min covers ticketing and the UCCA Store.

Fly from PKX.basis: Standard guidance is 2h before a domestic departure; PKX guides warn check-in closes 45 min out, security queues run 10-30 min and the 06:00-09:00 window is the airport's busiest.
